spec_notes: qrcode@1.5.4, pure JS, no browser/binary, installs cleanly. CJS package: import via `(await import('qrcode')).default` (ESM default interop — calling the namespace directly fails). QRCode.toBuffer(payload, {type:'png', width, margin}) returns a PNG Buffer. Input file contains the payload string (trimmed); QR_PAYLOAD env var can override payload if input file is absent/empty. Output is valid PNG (magic 89504e47 verified, ~2KB for short URLs). Width option is px; default margin 2 is module units. Payload length: very long strings (>~1KB) auto-raise QR version and can throw if too large — keep payloads short.
